100uF/35V radial electrolytic on V12. FUNCTIONAL NOT DECORATIVE: its 85mOhm ESR at 100kHz is the damping that holds the input filter's peak output impedance at 0.17 ohm against the converter's -106 ohm input impedance (design.md section 3 row 21). A low-ESR polymer substitute BREAKS the front end - any ECN must re-run that row. 35V so the SMAJ15A clamp (24.4V) cannot exceed it (NEW)

2.2uF/50V X7R 1210 - C8 is the LM3404 input capacitor (2x the 1.09uF minimum and 2x the rated Vin per TI SNVS465G 8.1.5). C11 sits across the LED terminals and splits the ripple so the LED sees 7% while the sense resistor still sees the 23% the CS comparator needs; it also damps the open-circuit ring (SNVS465G 7.3.9) (NEW)
